v4_additions.notes: Version 4 keeps the version 3 topology and nullable current_as_of date. Health observations and uncontracted candidate research are additive. The authenticated desk must accept 4 without dropping those fields or requiring candidate rows to appear in source_contracts.json. Desk overlay must keep the version 4 maintainer-architecture lede in its known intro set.

v5_additions.notes: Version 5 keeps the version 4 topology, counts and source fields. It adds the private repair-observation projection: structured source and join conditions carried on this backstage artifact so the authenticated desk can inspect them without reading resident copy. Records are keyed by a stable fingerprint over source, scope and condition only, so a repeated observation or a presentation-copy change resolves to the same record. Only the 'repair' disposition is engineering work; 'expected-absence' and 'source-policy-limitation' record that a state was evaluated and must never be presented as a defect or as a claim against a publisher. The consumer must accept 5 without dropping these fields and must not project any of them onto a public response.

v6_additions.notes: Version 6 keeps the version 5 topology, counts, source fields and repair-observation set. It adds the work grain over those observations: one issue per source contract, condition and adapter, carrying the affected-scope count, recency, the evidence that first recorded the condition, the owner, any existing engineering record and any resolution receipt. The issue key digests that identity alone, so a reworded condition detail, a newer last-seen instant, another affected scope or a fresh code revision folds into the issue that already exists. Only repair-candidate and regressed are engineering work; expected-absence and source-policy-limitation record that a condition was evaluated and correctly needs no repair. Nothing but the reviewed register can move an issue past the candidate verification state or into resolved, so the producer of a record verifies the deduplication rather than the pass asserting it. When status is 'unavailable' the counts are null and must not be rendered as zero: an unread queue and an empty queue are different answers. The consumer must accept 6 without dropping these fields and must not project any of them onto a public response.
